name: Tetteh Pipeworks
description: One-page site for a plumber in Tema. Cool off-white, deep pipe blue and copper with Barlow Condensed headings. A dark sticky header with the phone number, a hero with call and WhatsApp-a-photo buttons and three promises, and an original cutaway drawing of a Ghanaian house water system (polytank on a stand, pressure pump, meter, taps, WC, water heater, soakaway): tap a numbered spot to see usual causes, a price range, what to do before the plumber arrives and a button that preselects the booking form. Also a labour price table, a section on tank-and-pump setups for days the mains is off, service areas, three steps, two reviews, FAQ and a callback form with live opening hours.
